newsitem.title: USA: Hess in talks with several about refinery.
newsitem.headline: Hess in talks with several about refinery.

text.p: Amerada Hess Corp is in discussions with several Latin American government oil companies about joint venture ownership of the company's St. Croix refinery in the U.S. Virgin Islands, Chief Executive John Hess said Wednesday.

Speaking with reporters after the annual meeting, he said the company is also still interested in finding a venture partner for its East Coast gasoline marketing operations. However, the emphasis is in seeking a partner for the St. Croix refinery because that's where the company's major investment is, Hess said.

Hess told the annual meeting "Our marketing plan is to be the leading retail gasoline station and convenience store operator in the markets we serve." Its major marketing operations are in the metropolitan New York area and Florida, where it recently agreed to acquire 66 Pick Quick retail gasoline stations and convenience stores.

Hess said the company will start construction on 15 new gasoline stations and convenience stores in Florida this year. Later he told reporters three of these will be opened in early July and the company plans to build larger numbers of new stations in future years.
